title: Torus portals and lifts
notes: Keep one adult at each table and have spare aligned copies ready before a route reaches the array edge. First routes: K-1 P1-2 on portal destinations; grades 2-3 P1-2 before copy replay P3; grades 4-5 P1-3 before the square-slide rules. On return, K-1 can find home trips (P3) or try the two-pawn trade (P4). Grades 2-3 can compare finishing copies and construct returns to the original copy (P3-5). Grades 4-5 can use square slides and cancellation (P4-5) to reach the classification question (P6). Copy tracking is a continuation after ordinary seam crossing; the actual-mat tests remain unperformed.
